tf_name.description: Name of the transcription factor whose binding preference the motif describes, as given by the source, for example ATF1_HUMAN in HOCOMOCO.

pwm.description: Position weight matrix for the motif: an N-by-4 matrix with one row per motif position and one score per nucleotide. Scores are stored as strings.

length.description: Number of positions in the motif, equal to the number of rows in pwm.
